title: Time and sales
description: A trade tape: newest trades on top, sliding in and flashing, large trades bold and tinted, same-millisecond sweeps merged, size filters and a pause while hovered. Typed-array rings keep 200,000 trades; only the visible rows are drawn.

data.pausedHint: Paused while hovered: move away (or click the badge) to resume.
data.liveHint: Hover the tape to pause it, click a row to pick a trade.
data.pressureBalanced: Buy and sell flow are balanced.

support.notes: Native Angular: MnTimeAndSales. Native standalone component/directive; see platform tests for validated scope.

api.notes: Native Angular: MnTimeAndSales. Native standalone component/directive; see platform tests for validated scope.

examples.title: Large trades
examples.description: Trades reaching largeTradeThreshold are bold and tinted, more strongly up to 8 times the threshold. aggregate merges one aggressive order sweeping several levels (same side, same millisecond) into one row: sizes summed, the last price and the count of prints.

translationResources.title: Time and sales
translationResources.description: A trade tape: newest trades on top, sliding in and flashing, large trades bold and tinted, same-millisecond sweeps merged, size filters and a pause while hovered. Typed-array rings keep 200,000 trades; only the visible rows are drawn.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: trades takes the trades oldest first; the tape shows the newest on top. When the array grows (same items in front) only the new ones are added, otherwise the tape is replaced. The wheel or the scrollbar go through the history.

live.title: Live tape
live.description: Trades go through the ref (addTrades): new rows slide in and flash, one draw per frame. Hover to pause: the rows freeze and the badge counts the new trades; click it (or press Home) to jump back. onTradeClick gives the clicked trade.

large-trades.title: Large trades
large-trades.description: Trades reaching largeTradeThreshold are bold and tinted, more strongly up to 8 times the threshold. aggregate merges one aggressive order sweeping several levels (same side, same millisecond) into one row: sizes summed, the last price and the count of prints.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: minSize hides the rows smaller than a size (after aggregation); priceColor="tick" colors the price by its move from the previous trade. The kept history is filtered again on every change.

large-data.title: 100,000 trades
large-data.description: The framework-free engine (createTimeAndSales from minerva-design/charts/core) stores the trades in typed-array rings: 100,000 load in milliseconds and every click adds 100,000 more, up to capacity. Only the visible rows are drawn.

dark.title: Dark terminal
dark.description: A terminal palette on the CSS variables of the container, a monospace font and tick coloring (green on an uptick, red on a downtick).

compact.title: Compact (mobile)
compact.description: A phone panel: 17 px rows, seconds only (milliseconds={false}) and merged sweeps. Below 240 px wide the texts shrink and the side column is dropped.

red-up.title: Red up, green down
red-up.description: colorConvention="red-up": red buys, green sells (mainland China, Japan, Korea).

pressure.title: Buy / sell pressure
pressure.description: The trades sent to addTrades are also kept for a minute to compute rolling tape statistics twice a second: VWAP, volume bought and sold by aggressors, trades per second and the largest print. The tape itself merges sweeps (aggregate) and tints trades from 1 BTC (largeTradeThreshold).

clock.title: Time zones and custom formats
clock.description: formatTime replaces the built-in clock (local or UTC) with any Intl.DateTimeFormat, here in another time zone with milliseconds; formatPrice shows dollars and labels.time names the zone in the header.

block-alerts.title: Block trade alerts
block-alerts.description: Trades of the same side and millisecond (one sweep, as merged by aggregate) are summed: from 2 BTC they are logged with their average price and notional, and the same size is highlighted on the tape by largeTradeThreshold. Clear empties the tape through clear().

split.title: Buys and sells side by side
split.description: One feed, two tapes: the trades are split by aggressor side before addTrades, each tape with its own ariaLabel. The headers count the prints and the volume of each side, and the net flow sums them.

TimeAndSalesProps.trades: Trades, oldest first; when the array grows only the appended ones are added (other changes replace the tape)
TimeAndSalesProps.onHover: Hovered row (null when the pointer leaves)
TimeAndSalesProps.onTradeClick: Click, tap or Enter on a row
TimeAndSalesProps.onPause: The tape paused (hovered, scrolled or a row selected) or resumed
TimeAndSalesProps.ref: Imperative handle: addTrades, setTrades, clear, scrollToLatest, getInstance

TimeAndSalesHandle.scrollToLatest: Scrolls back to the newest trade and resumes

TimeAndSalesOptions.rowHeight: Height of a row, in pixels
TimeAndSalesOptions.minSize: Hides the rows smaller than this size (after aggregation)
TimeAndSalesOptions.largeTradeThreshold: Trades reaching this size are bold and tinted (stronger as they grow)
TimeAndSalesOptions.aggregate: Merges consecutive trades of the same side and millisecond into one row: sizes summed, the last price
TimeAndSalesOptions.priceColor: Colors the price by aggressor side, or by tick (up or down from the previous trade)
TimeAndSalesOptions.pauseOnHover: Freezes the rows while the pointer is over the tape (new trades are counted)
TimeAndSalesOptions.animate: New trades slide in and flash
TimeAndSalesOptions.header: Header row with the column names
TimeAndSalesOptions.milliseconds: Milliseconds in the default time format
TimeAndSalesOptions.timeZone: Clock of the default time format: the local time or UTC (the clock of most exchanges)
TimeAndSalesOptions.formatTime: Formats the time of a trade (replaces the default HH:MM:SS.mmm)
TimeAndSalesOptions.labels: Overrides of the built-in texts, which follow locale (English, Chinese, Japanese and French built in)

OrderBookCommonOptions.upColor: Color of the bids and buys (the "up" side); --success-color by default, --danger-color with colorConvention "red-up"
OrderBookCommonOptions.downColor: Color of the asks and sells (the "down" side); --danger-color by default, --success-color with colorConvention "red-up"
OrderBookCommonOptions.colorConvention: "red-up" swaps the default colors: red bids and buys, green asks and sells (mainland China, Japan, Korea)
OrderBookCommonOptions.pricePrecision: Decimals of the prices; inferred from the data when omitted
OrderBookCommonOptions.sizePrecision: Decimals of the sizes; inferred from the data when omitted
OrderBookCommonOptions.locale: Locale of the numbers (Intl.NumberFormat, compact units such as k or 万) and of the built-in texts (English, Chinese, Japanese, French); the page language (lang attribute of the html element) when omitted
OrderBookCommonOptions.formatPrice: Formats a price (replaces pricePrecision and locale)
OrderBookCommonOptions.formatSize: Formats a size (replaces sizePrecision and locale)
OrderBookCommonOptions.fontFamily: Font of the texts; the theme font when omitted (a monospace font aligns the digits)
OrderBookCommonOptions.fontSize: Font size of the texts, in pixels
OrderBookCommonOptions.ariaLabel: Accessible name of the widget; the localized labels.name when omitted

OrderBookWidgetProps.height: Height of the widget; numbers are pixels
OrderBookWidgetProps.width: Width of the widget; numbers are pixels

TimeAndSalesLabels.newTrades: Badge of the new trades above the view; {count} is replaced
TimeAndSalesLabels.name: Accessible name (when ariaLabel is not set)

TimeAndSalesRowEvent.trade: The trade (aggregated rows sum the sizes and keep the last price)
TimeAndSalesRowEvent.count: Trades merged into the row (1 without aggregation)

MarketTrade.side: Aggressor side: "buy" lifted an ask, "sell" hit a bid

TimeAndSalesInstance.addTrades: Appends trades (oldest first), drawn at the next frame
TimeAndSalesInstance.scrollToLatest: Scrolls back to the newest trade and resumes
TimeAndSalesInstance.on: Subscribes to an event (hover, tradeClick, pause); returns the unsubscribe function
TimeAndSalesInstance.resize: Measures the container again (a ResizeObserver does it automatically)
TimeAndSalesInstance.destroy: Removes the tape and its listeners

tape.title: Live tape
tape.description: A trade every 250 ms on top of the tape, large trades highlighted; hovering pauses it and counts the new trades.

large-trades.title: Aggregated tape, large trades
large-trades.description: 2,000 trades, consecutive ones of the same side and price merged, small ones hidden; click a row.

props.options: Other engine options (TimeAndSalesOptions of minerva-design/charts/core: colors, texts, locale, labels…); property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: A row is hovered; detail: { trade, count, index }, null when the pointer left
events.minerva-trade-click: A row was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { trade, count, index }
events.minerva-pause: The tape paused (pointer over it, scrolled down) or resumed; detail: { paused }

methods.scrollToLatest: Scrolls back to the newest trade and resumes
